text: Merged 745c5ab (branch d29135e). studio-core, studio-app and studio-viz (JVM+JS) and studio-desktop (JVM, OpenJFX 24.0.1, minimum JDK 22, -Djavafx.platform override). All are kept out of root, compileAll and testAll. The studioAll and studioStyleCheck aliases exist. StudioLint and checkModuleBoundaries are extended with self-tests. On main, studioAll, checkBoundaries, studioStyleCheck, headerCheckAll and scalafmtCheckAll are green under GITHUB_ACTIONS=true. The CI fastLinkJS job moves to S0.4.
